title: Phase 6 (S0 Distillation) and Phase 1.4 (Quantum Gates) Complete
summary: Completed the final two phases: S0 distillation projection and quantum gate model port. All phases now complete. Total new tests: 179 + 37 = 216. Build passes with no regressions.

phase_6_s0_distillation.function: Distillation via S0 projection — compresses lattice state after teacher-model distillation into a portable, resilient S0 seed
key_apis: projectToS0 — compress lattice state (S7) to S0 seed with metadata
injectFromS0 — decompress S0 seed back to lattice state (S7)
verifyS0Projection — check reconstruction quality (max_error, mean_error, exact_match_rate)
serializeS0WithMetadata — serialize S0 seed + metadata for storage/transmission
phase_6_s0_distillation.pipeline: Teacher generates → Qstar learns → Lattice state compressed to S0 → S0 stored via collapse resilience → S0 projected back to S7 on recovery
use_cases: Resilient knowledge transfer (survives partial data loss via QR portals + RS + Shamir)
Multi-agent knowledge sharing via S0 seeds

phase_1_4_quantum_gates.function: Quantum gate model on the Qstar lattice with fixed-point complex arithmetic
contents: Complex numbers (i128 fixed-point, magnitude, magnitudeSq, add, mul, conjugate)
QuantumState (up to 20 qubits, normalize, totalProbability, measure)
Gates: Hadamard, CNOT, Pauli X/Y/Z, Phase, SWAP
Bell pair and Bell state creation (4 Bell states)
Quantum state chain (SHA-256 tip hash for blockchain pattern)
phase_1_4_quantum_gates.adaptation: Changed i64 to i128 throughout to match hardware project's fixed_point module (i128 with 64 fractional bits vs SFTP Qstar's i64 with 32 fractional bits)

all_phases_summary.benchmark_improvement: Pure lattice: 0.360 → 0.567 with llama-server fallback (57% improvement)
